analysis.title: Deleveraging Alert: US Equity L/S "On"; US Quant, EU Equity L/S & JP Equity L/S Activate
key_insights: Equity L/S hedge funds in the UBS PB Book de-grossed -0.8std of US equities and -2.6std of EU equities on 11/2. Combined with continued losses in consensus trades (Hyperscalers, Semis), this triggered the US and Europe Equity L/S deleveraging indicators.
UBS's prediction framework forecasts further deleveraging on 11/3, based on its performance estimates.
US de-grossing was concentrated in Semis. UBS PrimeView notes AI de-grossing rotating back to Semis and profit taking in Healthcare & Longevity.
European de-grossing was broad-based across sectors, driven by both short covering and long selling.
US Quants cut -1.0std of gross exposure while EU Quants added +1.1std. The US Quant indicator has triggered and the EU Quant indicator remains Off.
Japan Equity L/S has triggered on performance losses. Japan Quant is close to the threshold but not active.
risk_factors: Further deleveraging projected for 11/3 by UBS's prediction framework.
